prompt: A clean, modern desktop app screenshot: the settings pane of an encrypted note-taking tool. Flat straight-on view of the interface only — no browser chrome, no window title bar, no device frame, no cursor. Layout: a narrow left sidebar of setting categories, and a main pane of stacked setting rows, each a label on the left and a toggle switch or small dropdown on the right. Three toggles are on, in violet. A boxed panel near the bottom holds a row of small key-shaped glyphs. Visual style: near-white cool grey page background, pure white panels, hairline light grey borders, 4px corner radius, generous whitespace, completely flat with no gradients, no glow, no shadows, no 3D. CRITICAL: render every piece of text as soft light-grey rounded placeholder bars of varying widths. Absolutely no legible letters, words, numbers, or logos anywhere in the image.
